title: Lanework common definitions
description: The value families every document shares. A lenient family is a canonical branch beside a retired one, and the retired branch carries `deprecated: true`.

schema-version.description: The format version, `1`. No coercion: a value that is not an integer has no reading.

lenient-text.description: Any scalar reads as the text the author typed; a sequence or mapping has no reading.

lenient-text-single-line.description: A title. Any scalar reads as the text the author typed; the text never carries a line break.

lenient-integer.description: An integer, a whole-number double, or a numeric string; a fractional value has no reading.

lenient-number.description: A rank among the parent's children. The canonical value is a number; anything else reads as absent, which sorts the item last.

anyOf.description: The canonical rank. The app always writes a number.

Read as absent — append-at-end — by IntegrityRules.resolvedOrder (coerce-tier, silent, bytes preserved): an explicitly null key, a non-numeric scalar, and a non-finite one such as `.nan`, which YAML writes as a scalar JSON has no number for. A mapping or a sequence reads the same way, but nothing writes one.

lenient-bool.description: A boolean, or one of YAML 1.1's boolean words written quoted. The reader lowercases before matching, so the spellings listed here are the whole set in any casing; anything else has no reading.

timestamp.description: A YAML 1.1 timestamp — a calendar day, or a day with a time and an optional zone — as its source text, never a resolved instant. The pattern is Yams' own `Constructor.timestampPattern`: seconds are required once a time is present, the zone is `Z` (uppercase) or ±hh[:mm], and month, day and hour take one digit or two.

uuid.description: A UUID, 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal in any case and any version. The app writes lowercase v4.

identity.description: Who acted: a display name, `human` or `agent`, and an agent's model.

name.description: The display name every surface that renders an identity shows.

kind.description: `human` or `agent`, as written. The value is never policed.

model.description: An agent's model name or level. Meaningless on a human.

roster-ref.description: The GUID of the agent's card on the roster board — a bare UUID, never a path.

stamp.description: When it happened and who did it.

anyOf.description: Retired: a bare timestamp scalar, read as the stamp's `at` with no identity. Write the mapping.

icon.description: The item's SF Symbol and the tint it wears.

glyph.description: An SF Symbol name. Never checked against the system catalogue: an unknown name draws the level's default.

color.description: A palette name spelled exactly as the palette spells it, or a `#RRGGBB[AA]` hex.

anyOf.description: Retired: a bare scalar, read as `{glyph: …}`. Write the mapping.

background.description: Lane and card only. `{color: …}` — a mapping is the only shape; a bare scalar has no reading.

color.description: A palette name or a `#RRGGBB[AA]` hex. An absent colour paints nothing.

waiting.description: Card only. The card is blocked on a human's reply. Set by an agent; removed by the app once a human has commented on the card later than `since`. A mapping is the only shape.

for.description: Whose attention is asked for — which machine draws the mark: a handle matched case-insensitively, or `human` / `operator` for any human. Absent means any human.

since.description: When the flag was set. A human comment created strictly later than this is what clears it; without a readable `since` the app never clears the flag.

comment.description: The uuid of the ask comment on this card's own thread. Identity-shaped or no reading at all — a bare identity, never a path.

group.description: How a lane's cards are sectioned on screen.

by.description: `modified`, `created`, `due`, `priority` or `component`. A name this build does not know reads as no grouping and keeps its bytes.

direction.description: `ascending` or `descending` (the default), `asc`/`desc` read as synonyms. Reorders sections only.

anyOf.description: Retired: a bare scalar, read as `{by: …}`. Write the two-subkey mapping.

labels.description: A card's labels — a list of self-sufficient label maps, each carrying everything a reader needs.

label.description: One label, carrying every property its definition had at write time — the stamps are the whole answer at read.

text.description: The identity within its kind, compared case-insensitively, display spelling preserved.

rank.description: The number a ranked kind sorts by, and the exact grouping key. Absent on an open kind.

color.description: The value's own colour, already flattened at write: its own, else its kind's.

icon.description: The value's own mark. Never inherited from the kind: a value with no icon stamps none.

kind.description: The kind this value belongs to. Absent means implied by context — `default` in a list, the key's own kind on `priority`/`component`, the containing definition on a `values` entry. A built-in kind is never stamped.

sugar-label.description: One label at a sugar key — `priority` or `component`. The key names the kind, so the value never carries one.

text.description: The identity within its kind, compared case-insensitively, display spelling preserved.

rank.description: The number a ranked kind sorts by, and the exact grouping key. Absent on an open kind.

color.description: The value's own colour, already flattened at write: its own, else its kind's.

icon.description: The value's own mark. Never inherited from the kind: a value with no icon stamps none.

kind.description: Forbidden here: the key names the kind, and a stamped `kind` on a sugar value is not read.

label-kind.description: The identity and presentation of a kind of label.

type.description: The identity — kebab-case, matched case-insensitively. `default`, `priority` and `component` are built in.

text.description: The optional display name; absent displays as the type.

color.description: The kind's own colour, separate from any value's.

icon.description: The kind's own mark; in compact presentation it stands in for the kind's name.

label-names.description: LabelValue names, deduplicated case-insensitively with the first spelling winning.

anyOf.description: A bare scalar reads as a one-element list. The app always writes the list.

label-kinds.description: LabelValue kinds. A sequence is the only shape with a reading.

type.description: The kind's identity, and what a shadowing definition matches on.

color.description: The kind's own colour — a palette name or a hex.

single.description: A card carries at most one value of this kind. A writer's constraint, never a read-time collapse.

values.description: Present — even empty — makes the kind closed: a card value names one of these by text, and stamps its rank.

legacy-priority-roster.description: The retired priority roster. Not read at all since 2026-09-07: a level still carrying it keeps its bytes, and it converts once into a `priority` entry under `labels` / `default-labels`.

name.description: What a card's own `priority` key writes and a human reads.

value.description: The sort key. Lowest value is the highest priority.

color.description: Tints the chip's text and outline only; the capsule stays unfilled.

anyOf.description: A bare name, read as `{name, value: its 1-based position}`.

thumb-sizes.description: Square-fit thumbnail sizes, each naming a generatable `thumb.<N>.png`. An explicit `[]` is a real, empty roster.

anyOf.description: A bare scalar reads as a one-element list. The app always writes the list.

palette-colors.description: A named colour table, unioned over the built-in one with per-name shadowing.

name.description: The kebab-case identity board files write, matched exactly.

rgb.description: A `#RRGGBB` hex, six digits: transparency is `alpha`, never folded in here.

alpha.description: 0–1, default 1. Above the top clamps; a negative reads as 1.

filter-clauses.description: Which of a lane's cards show. AND across clauses; a clause this build cannot read is dropped and the rest apply.

op.description: `older`/`newer` for a date clause, `equal`/`not-equal` for the others.

value.description: A duration `Nm`/`Nh`/`Nd`/`Nw` for a date clause, a name for the others.

reactions.description: A comment's emoji reactions. A sequence is the only shape with a reading; an entry nobody can name is dropped.

logging.description: The board log's own settings, cascaded board → global → built-in `off`.

retain.description: Days of log files to keep. A negative or unreadable value reads as absent, never as `0`.

anyOf.description: A bare scalar reads as `level` alone, and carries no `retain`. The app always writes the mapping.

order.description: Display position in the template chooser.

role.description: The role this board plays in a multi-board workspace (pipeline, roster, archive, design, review, …). Open vocabulary, trusted and never policed.
